⭐ 140 222 stars · 🍴 13 385 forks · 🐍 Python · 📜 Apache-2.0

━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧭 WHAT IT DOES
Turn your complex documents and code folders into an interactive visual map so you can find connections and trace paths in seconds instead of searching manually.

✨ WHAT STANDS OUT
• Parse ~40 languages locally via tree-sitter without sending code to an LLM
• Tag every connection as explicitly extracted or resolved via graph inference
• Generate standalone interactive HTML graphs alongside JSON and Markdown reports
• Trace multi-hop paths between distinct symbols across an entire project

📌 WHY IT MATTERS
Local AST parsers have matured enough to handle multi-language cross-file links deterministically without relying on heavy vector stores.

🎯 GOOD FIT FOR
Developers working in large codebases who want to query code relationships rather than grepping files.

⚡ QUICK START
uv tool install graphifyy
